# Original regression corpus

These minimal documents were authored for texlive-wasm and use its MIT license. They do not copy publisher templates.

- article: math, tables, hyperlink, reference and an actual BibTeX bibliography.
- report: multiple includes, cross-chapter references, contents/bookmarks and partial/full builds.
- slides: Beamer lists, icons and multiple frames.

External ACM, IEEE, Elsevier, Springer and institutional templates can be tested with the optional corpus runner manifest. Their sources and licenses remain with their respective owners; no third-party template is redistributed here.
